title: Queue Heat Kiosk Field Lab
oneLiner: Field operators test kiosk queue friction with body-language notes, senior help moments, and abandonment triggers.
theme: 외로움 / 건강 / 역전 - offline service dignity, accessibility, and queue survival.
targetUser: Cafe/franchise operators, retail ops teams, accessibility testers, and kiosk vendors observing real-world queue frustration.
keyUX: Observer runs a live field test: logs queue length, hesitation, help requests, failed taps, senior/disabled friction, and abandonment; the app turns observations into a retrofit brief.
requiredUISections: Live queue heat header with wait time, abandonment, and assist events
Body-language tap log for hesitation, backtracking, and shoulder checks
Senior and accessibility help moment recorder
Retrofit recommendation board for signage, flow, and fallback ordering
sourceSignals: S11 - Korea Herald, delivery app fees nearly double sustainable restaurant level: https://www.koreaherald.com/article/10671343
S12 - Biz Chosun, Korea pushes delivery-app total burden disclosure and SME bargaining: https://biz.chosun.com/en/en-industry/2026/06/16/SHUJ4ZLBYZETBGVEEJ5LGCE5SM/
stitchPrompt: Build a production-grade mobile-first web app prototype called "Queue Heat Kiosk Field Lab" for retail and cafe operators observing kiosk queue friction in the field. The first screen must be a live field-test tool with a queue heat header, body-language tap log, kiosk screen friction checklist, senior and accessibility help recorder, staff interruption timer, retrofit recommendation board, and before/after test report export. Use realistic sample data: lunchtime cafe queue, eight customers observed, two senior help moments, one failed coupon scan, 38-second average hesitation, one abandoned order, and a handwritten staff workaround. Design direction: use the field-ops profile with glove-friendly mobile controls, high-contrast event chips, rugged observation cards, and one vivid cyan action accent for the next field note. Do not make a marketing landing page; the first screen must be the working app.
